S09-Chair-Open.dc.html.title: 9 · PASS → the chair is open (20s pick window)

t1.text: A · BROADCAST NOIR — the show's own graphics, neon on ink

n1.text: A rules: the photo is the card, everywhere. Lower-thirds, not boxes. Kickers in mono, names in Baloo, body in Archivo. Two buttons in the whole app: KEEP (pink bevel) and PASS (purple bevel). Teal is for the clock and show mechanics only. Gold is hearts. Nothing is a gradient wash; glow is on edges and type, like a sign.

t2.text: B · LATE EDITION — daylight, editorial, the show as a ticket

n2.text: B rules: paper ground, ink type, ONE red. Photos sit in white frames like a program. Every show element is a ticket stub (perforated edge, mono numbers). Serif display for names and headlines, sans for everything else. The neon lives only in the live state: the moment a show is on, the ticket turns black and the red lights up. Less glow, more print.

t3.text: STORYBOARD — one show, frame by frame, in direction A

n3.text: Read left to right, then the second row. Frames 4 and 8 are HER view (the host); the rest are the crowd's. The mock follows the show as built (tools/SEQUENCE-show.md): choosing 20s, an answer 30s, open floor 45s, three rounds, deliberation 60s, her call 60s, a PASS opens a 20s pick window, KEEP ends the show. Grey mono text under each frame is a caption for you, not UI.

n0.text: NAV: four tabs, always there — ♥ Swipe is HOME (open the app, you're on a card). 📺 Shows is the show layer: live now, up next, GO LIVE, Schedule. 💬 Matches is Tinder's layout. ☺ You is your card and VIP. The only show thing on the Swipe tab is the LIVE NOW pill at the top. Tap the tabs in Play to walk it. THE ROOM, as built: a chair is either ON (answering) or just seated — nobody is KEPT mid-show. KEEP ONE is the winner and ends the show; PASS ONE sends one chair home and the other two stay for a fresh 3-round cycle. KEPT appears only after a win (Matches badge, Backstage).
